caption:
Rugged rock formations meet the endless blue, inviting exploration with every step. This stretch of Costa Rica’s coastline rewards the adventurous with views that make the journey unforgettable.

Formaciones rocosas y un azul infinito invitan a la exploración en cada paso. Este tramo de la costa de Costa Rica recompensa a los aventureros con vistas inolvidables.
